title: Consider retry mechanism for guest session claim after timeout
body: After the 5s timeout, the guest session upgrade is skipped and the login succeeds. However, the cookie is retained (GUEST_SESSION_COOKIE_NAME is not cleared), which allows for retry. Consider implementing a background retry mechanism or a deferred claim that runs after login completes, so guest sessions can still be upgraded even after a timeout.
rationale: Currently, if the guest claim times out, the user keeps their guest session cookie and their conversations are not transferred to their account. A retry mechanism would ensure these users can still upgrade their sessions.
